name: Haramase Saimin Kan JK to Zetsurin Kimo Oyaji
original_name: 孕ませ催眠姦 JKと絶倫キモオヤジ
source: Oya is an old man who lives his peaceful life as a NEET. One day by chance, he discovers the hypnosis app that allows him to issue a command to anyone he takes picture of. Without a second thought he uses new gain power and starts working as a fake counselor in a neighborhood school. Now he gets to target his beloved idol, cocky student council president or anyone else he ever desires.
translation: Oya是一位老人，过着平静的NEET生活。有一天，他偶然发现了一款​​催眠应用程序，可以让他向任何他拍照的人发出命令。他不假思索地使用了新的增益力量，开始在附近的学校担任假辅导员。现在，他可以瞄准他心爱的偶像、傲慢的学生会主席或任何他想要的人。
